capabilities: Index images and videos referenced in Markdown across selected source folders
Display media as a single-column feed or masonry grid with carousels and a full-screen lightbox
Publish new photos and videos into timestamped daily notes with per-media captions
Filter the feed by source, year and date range
Update the index incrementally as files change or late-arriving media appears
disambiguation: Not an RSS reader; "feed" here means a photo timeline built from media embedded in your own notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer (declarative settings API); version 1.6.4 is the last release supporting older versions. Remote images need a network connection and orphan images never referenced in a note are not indexed.
motivation: The author wanted a dedicated place to look back at photos scattered across journals, social-media archives and quick notes without restructuring the vault or moving files.
problem: Photos referenced in notes are scattered across many folders, so looking back at what you shot means digging through the file tree with no dedicated place to browse them.

relations.evidence: If you have BRAT installed, simply add this repository's URL.

summary: Media viewer that indexes images and videos referenced in chosen folders and lays them out as an Instagram-style feed or masonry grid.
